name: failure
description: Something you had valued is gone and you perceive the loss was due to your own actions.

variations.name: garden variety failure
variations.description: An experience we take in stride and learn from.

variations.name: failure sickness
variations.description: An overreaction to a mistake with a perceived loss of social status and sense of shame.

variations.name: failure in others
variations.description: Disappointment in the actions of others.

commentaries.quote: Some of us are all too ready to blame ourselves for small things. Others are unwilling to recognize even big mistakes.
Fear of failure can keep us from trying anything.
Brain patterns cannot get better without the recalibration that comes from both success and failure.

conditions: The state of the world is perceived to have changed in a negative way and is viewed as the self's fault.
